decisions.reason: Because the firm has already invested in this software, presented it prominently, and it fits the announced move toward data-driven infrastructure management, management would likely continue and justify the commitment for at least another year.
Public commitment is weaker than for A, but as a close-to-core archiving and reporting product in a growing and innovative business area, it is still more likely to be retained than withdrawn.

This product is less central to the firm's digital future than the software offers, yet its visible launch and fit with the established water-infrastructure portfolio make management inclined to keep it rather than concede failure now.

As a recently launched automation and system software product with its own page and strong alignment with connected, secure, and predictive operations, it would typically receive continued support under an escalation-of-commitment logic.
